lines: One man commented a hundred and fifty-two times to save his army.
In my game, every comment was one artillery shell. For one day, both sides fired at each other's bunkers.
On the Concord side, one soldier fired more than anyone. Florian Monkey. A hundred and fifty-two shells. Half of everything his side fired.
But the Hegemony fired together. Otto Tyner, eighty-three. Brandon, sixty-seven. Angel, forty-six. And dozens more.
Three hundred and eighty-three shells, against three hundred and one.
The Hegemony guns knocked out forty-one percent of the Concord bunkers.
One man can't win a war alone.
Your side needs you. Comment Hegemony or Concord.
